title: Internal: handling procedure for lapsing and expiring a Personal Training Packages package
content:
## Applicable situation
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line. When a package's expiration window has passed while it is still active or paused, the agent lapses the package to expired status and forfeits the appropriate number of unused sessions.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): lapse_expire_package_bc252d9e.

## Parameters
- pt_holding_id: the reference number of the personal-training package being lapsed, reachable by looking up the member's packages before this call.
- forfeited_sessions: the whole number of sessions to forfeit from the package, a non-negative whole number of sessions, passed as the computed number of sessions actually forfeited at the moment of lapsing.

## Return
On success, a confirmation naming the new ledger entry's reference number, the number of sessions forfeited, and the package's new status; the status reading expired indicates the lapse was recorded successfully, and the package's session balance is reduced by the forfeited amount, down to zero. If the named package does not exist, the tool returns an error stating that no personal-training package matches the given reference number, and no ledger entry is created.
